# uptimekuma_notification_teltonika (Resource)

Teltonika notification resource. Uses a Teltonika RUTxxx series router as an SMS gateway over its HTTP API. This provider is only compatible with Teltonika RutOS >= 7.14.0 devices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Teltonika notification using the router's default modem
resource "uptimekuma_notification_teltonika" "sms" {
  name         = "Teltonika SMS"
  url          = "https://192.168.1.1"
  username     = "admin"
  password     = "your-router-password"
  phone_number = "+1234567890"
  is_default   = false
}

# Teltonika notification with a specific modem and a self-signed certificate
resource "uptimekuma_notification_teltonika" "self_signed" {
  name         = "Teltonika SMS (self-signed)"
  url          = "https://teltonika.example.com:8080"
  username     = "admin"
  password     = "your-router-password"
  modem        = "1-1"
  phone_number = "+1234567890,+1234567891"
  unsafe_tls   = true
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: password_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change password_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_teltonika" "write_only" {
  name = "Teltonika with a write-only secret"

  url          = "https://192.168.1.1"
  username     = "admin"
  phone_number = "+1234567890"

  password_wo         = "your-router-password"
  password_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `phone_number` (String) The recipient phone number (e.g., "+336xxxxxxxx"). Multiple recipients can be provided as a comma-separated list.
- `url` (String) Teltonika router base URL (e.g., https://192.168.1.1).
- `username` (String) The router user used to authenticate against the Teltonika HTTP API.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `modem` (String) The modem identifier on the router (e.g., "1-1").
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password for the router user. Stored in state; use `password_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Teltonika router password, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `password`; requires `password_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `password_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `password` until the next apply with `password_wo` set removes it from state.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `password_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `password_wo`.
- `unsafe_tls` (Boolean) Disables TLS certificate validation when communicating with the router. This is useful for routers using a self-signed certificate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
